# What is First Noble Step?
First Noble Step is the official membership portal empowering Pakistan's:
- Entrepreneurs seeking business funding, business plan evaluation, and CEO networking
- Students seeking paid internships (e-internship 100% free online), scholarships, study abroad opportunities
- Job Professionals seeking global jobs, overseas placements, resume optimization, LinkedIn review

# Membership Packages & Pricing (PKR)
- Basic Package: PKR 2,500 (was 5,000, 50% OFF) - Resume & CV optimization, Job search strategy, Fresh Graduate Job List, 30-Day Action Plan, Job Scam Awareness
- Standard Package: PKR 6,999 (was 14,000, 50% OFF) - Everything in Basic + Salary negotiation, 1-on-1 call, LinkedIn profile review, Career roadmap, Networking, Prestige Certificate
- Premium Package (Professional): PKR 14,999 (was 30,000, 50% OFF) - Everything in Standard + Verified Badge, Industry Connections, Global Exposure, High-Level Jobs, Exclusive Events, Noble Career Champion Award, International Jobs & Study Support
- Entrepreneur Package: PKR 49,999 (was 70,000, Save 20,000) - Business Plan Evaluation, Strategic feedback, Funding chance, Powerful Networking, CEO/CXO access, Verified business certificate, Logo visibility, B2B collaborations, Business Awards, Legacy Card
- E-Internship: FREE - 100% online from home, no fixed timing, no office visit, online projects, beginner friendly, real work experience, physical certificate delivered (PKR 1500 at end)

# How to Apply
1. Visit https://firstnoblestep.com
2. Click Apply Now
3. Select Package (Students & Professionals or Business Growth or Programs)
4. Enter: Full Name (as per Passport/ID), Email Address, WhatsApp Number (923...), Postal Address (for internship), University (optional)
5. Verify Email with 6-digit OTP code (expires 10 min)
6. Complete Payment: Faysal Bank Limited, Account Title: FIRST NOBLE STEP (PRIVATE) LIMITED, Account Number: 3291499000005525, IBAN: PK03FAYS3291499000005525
7. Upload Receipt (JPG/PNG/WEBP, max 1MB)
8. Review & Accept Privacy Policy & Terms
9. Submit - Team verifies within 72 working hours
